headline: TECAT introduces the TECAT 468 Single Channel and Dual Channel
summary: The new wireless strain systems come in 4,000, 6,000, and 8,000 Hz versions and debut at Automotive Testing Expo North America 2026.

headline: Visit TECAT at Automotive Testing Expo North America 2026
summary: TECAT exhibits October 27 to 29, 2026, in Novi, Michigan.

headline: TECAT exhibits at Automotive Testing Expo North America
summary: TECAT exhibited its wireless telemetry systems at the October show in Novi, Michigan.

headline: NHRA and tractor pulling teams order TECAT telemetry
summary: Following a rule change, teams including Kalitta Motorsports and John Force Racing ordered TECAT systems, as did NTPA tractor pulling teams.

headline: TECAT releases high-resolution single-channel and CAN-output dual-channel systems
summary: The single-channel system adds a 16-bit A/D converter, and the dual-channel system adds a CAN interface for vehicle data networks.

headline: Second-generation wireless load cell electronics launch
summary: The second generation of TECAT load cell electronics launched in late 2024, and Flintec introduced its next-generation CC PRO wireless load cell built on it in 2025.

headline: TECAT introduces new products at Automotive Testing Expo North America
summary: TECAT exhibited in October and introduced its new high-resolution single-channel and CAN-output dual-channel systems.

headline: IntelliTork with TECAT telemetry installs 30,000 helical piles at a solar farm
summary: Contractors used Pro-Dig USA's IntelliTork system, with TECAT wireless telemetry inside, to record installation torque on the solar farm's piles.

headline: TECAT adds a pass-by-noise measurement system to its standard offering
summary: The system, first developed with Cummins, is now available to other vehicle test programs.

headline: First production rod-rotation sensing load cells ship through Flintec
summary: The load cells add wireless rod rotation sensing for artificial lift wells. TECAT developed the capability with Flintec and Marathon Oil, which field tested it in North Dakota in 2023.

headline: TECAT demonstrates multi-channel landing gear temperature measurement
summary: A demonstration measured temperature wirelessly at several points on aircraft landing gear.

headline: TECAT exhibits at Automotive Testing Expo North America
summary: TECAT met with test and validation engineers at the October show in Novi, Michigan.

headline: TECAT exhibits at Automotive Testing Expo North America
summary: TECAT exhibited its wireless telemetry systems at the October show.

headline: TECAT develops a pass-by-noise measurement system for Cummins
summary: TECAT built the system on its wireless telemetry technology, and it passed field trials in early 2023.

headline: IntelliTork systems with TECAT telemetry in use on four continents
summary: Pro-Dig USA customers in the United States, Canada, South America, and Europe use the system to measure installation torque on foundation piles.

headline: TECAT exhibits at Automotive Testing Expo North America
summary: TECAT showed its wireless torque and strain telemetry systems to test engineers at the October show.

headline: Flintec begins producing wireless load cells under a TECAT technology license
summary: Flintec now builds TECAT wireless electronics into its load cells under a multi-year firmware license.

headline: Next-generation IntelliTork launches with TECAT wireless telemetry
summary: Pro-Dig USA began receiving production systems in January 2021, and the program finished with a new handheld unit and cloud reporting.

headline: TECAT begins renting test and measurement systems
summary: Test programs can rent a TECAT system for a project instead of buying one. The first rental system went to Cummins.

headline: TECAT receives a U.S. patent for avionics performance indication
summary: The patent covers an integrated wireless data system for avionics performance indication, invented by founder Dr. Douglas Baker.

headline: TECAT receives a U.S. patent for drilling rig leg monitoring
summary: The patent covers continuous monitoring of leg position and loading on a drilling rig.

headline: TECAT receives a U.S. patent for wireless pump control
summary: The patent covers an integrated wireless data system and method for pump control.

headline: TECAT and Pro-Dig USA begin developing the next-generation IntelliTork system
summary: IntelliTork measures torque and position on foundation drilling augers. A proof-of-concept field trial in Kansas followed in June 2020.

headline: TECAT wireless load cell electronics for Flintec earn FCC and IC certification
summary: The electronics, licensed to Flintec for its CC1W wireless load cell in January 2020, were certified for the U.S. and Canadian markets, and production units began shipping to Flintec customers in April.

headline: TECAT Announces Licensure Agreement for Wireless Axial Load Cell Electronics Capability
summary: TECAT licensed its wireless electronics, which pair position data with load for artificial lift, to Flintec, Inc. for the CC1W load cell, removing the need for an inclinometer on the pump jack.

headline: TECAT Announces Patent for Wireless Axial Load Cell and Sensor Assembly Capability
summary: TECAT announced its patent for the Wireless Axial Load Cell and Sensor Assembly, the WISER LC100, which combines position data with load for artificial lift so the pump jack no longer needs an inclinometer.

headline: TECAT Now Shipping WISER 8000 Wireless Strain Measuring and Monitoring System
summary: TECAT released the WISER 8000 Wireless Strain Measuring and Monitoring System and scheduled it for Automotive Testing Expo North America 2018, October 23 to 25 in Novi, Michigan.

headline: TECAT Signs Representative Agreement with Barnstorm Aviation Solutions, LLC
summary: TECAT signed a sales representative agreement with Barnstorm Aviation Solutions.

headline: TECAT Expands U.S. Rep Network to Rocky Mountain States
summary: TECAT added Technologies West RMS to its U.S. manufacturers' representative network to cover the Rocky Mountain states.

headline: TECAT Expands U.S. Rep Network to Mid-Atlantic, California, and Nevada
summary: TECAT added Sentech Measurements Inc. and Measurements Inc. to its U.S. manufacturers' representative network to cover the Mid-Atlantic, California, and Nevada.

headline: TECAT to Demonstrate WISER 4000 Wireless Torque Measuring and Monitoring System for Petroleum Industry at 2016 PBIOS
summary: TECAT scheduled the WISER 4000 wireless torque measuring and monitoring system for the 2016 Permian Basin International Oil Show, October 18 to 20 in Odessa, Texas.

headline: TECAT Introduces New Wireless Temperature Measurement and Monitoring System for Automotive Brake Rotors
summary: TECAT introduced the first product in its WISER TC family of temperature measurement and monitoring systems, built for automotive brake rotors.

headline: TECAT Now Shipping WISER 4000 Wireless Torque Measuring and Monitoring System
summary: TECAT began shipping the WISER 4000 wireless torque measuring and monitoring system for automotive, industrial, energy, and aviation applications.

headline: TECAT to Demonstrate WISER 4000 Wireless Torque Measuring and Monitoring System in Automotive Applications at Sensors Expo & Conference 2016
summary: TECAT scheduled the WISER 4000 wireless torque measuring and monitoring system for Sensors Expo & Conference 2016, June 21 to 23 in San Jose, California.

headline: TECAT to Debut Next-Generation Wireless Motion Sensor System at Automotive Testing Expo Europe 2016
summary: TECAT scheduled the next generation of its WISER wireless motion sensor system to debut at Automotive Testing Expo Europe 2016, May 31 to June 2 in Stuttgart, Germany.

headline: TECAT Introduces Custom Enclosures for Protection of WISER 2030-S Wireless Torque Sensor's Remote Unit and Battery
summary: TECAT introduced custom-built remote enclosures for the WISER 2030-S wireless torque sensor.

headline: TECAT Announces First Wireless Torque Sensor Model Featuring Shunt Calibration
summary: TECAT released the WISER 2030-S, the first version of its wireless torque sensor with shunt calibration.

headline: TECAT Sponsors Baja SAE and Formula SAE Intercollegiate Design Competitions
summary: TECAT sponsored the Baja SAE and Formula SAE intercollegiate design competitions, part of the SAE Collegiate Design Series.

headline: TECAT to Showcase WISER Model 2030 Wireless Torque Measuring and Monitoring System at the Annual Advanced Automotive Diagnostics Systems Summit
summary: TECAT planned live demonstrations at the Summit of the WISER Model 2030 monitoring strain in flex plates and measuring temperature and vibration to predict U-joint failure.

headline: TECAT Announces the Launch of the WISER 2030 Torque Telemetry System
summary: TECAT launched the WISER 2030 torque telemetry system with onboard data logging and triggering and remote flash.

headline: TECAT Signs Sales Representative Agreement with Stress Analysis Services
summary: TECAT added Stress Analysis Services, a test and measurement partner, to its sales team through a representative agreement.
